clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Bright, balanced, and unmistakably real. We age organic Assam black tea with true bergamot oil for several weeks, allowing the citrus to fully infuse into the leaf rather than simply coating it. The result is a rounder, more integrated cup than teas flavored with bergamot essence alone. We start with fuller leaf, hand-plucked Assam from Tonganagaon, the largest organic Fair Trade tea estate in India. Larger leaves have more surface area to unfurl and steep evenly, releasing flavor gradually instead of the fast, tannic bitterness typical of machine-picked fannings and dust used in many tea bags. Sourcing from Tonganagaon also means your tea purchase supports Numi's Together for H2OPE project, which has brought clean water and sanitation to more than 6,500 farming families at the estate. Every tea bag is made from manila hemp (Abacá) fiber, sealed with a crimp-and-knot process instead of the plastic heat-seals used in most tea bags, so no polypropylene ever touches your cup. The bags are BPI Certified Biodegradable and supplier-verified free of added plastics or microplastics — not just labeled that way. The outer wrapper is plant-based and commercially compostable, made from FSC-certified paper and non-GMO sugarcane. Each bag is USDA Certified Organic and Fair Trade Certified. Steep 3–5 minutes in fresh, boiling water for a classic cup, hot or iced.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Organic French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. Before we are born, chondrocytes work rapidly to build protection into our developing skeletons. Then we are born, grow, and age. The older we become, the slower chondrocytes work. As chondrocyte activity flags over time, they eventually fail to adequately compensate for the daily wear and tear placed on joints by an active lifestyle. As a result, nearly everyone has some degree of cartilage breakdown by the age of 32 to 35. For centuries it was thought that the gradual deterioration made joint pain and loss of mobility an inevitable fact of aging. Cartilage can indeed be brought back to greater levels of health, strengthened and thickened if proper nutrients are supplied. There is one controlling principle in the effort to rebuild cartilage: There must be some cartilage with viable chondrocytes in the joint in order for repair to proceed. If prior joint surgeries have removed all cartilage, or if all cartilage in the joint has been worn completely away, then there would be no chondrocytes on site that could initiate the reconstruction process. But most damaged joints do retain a good measure of cartilage. They can benefit from Joint Vibrance.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: “On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It’s visceral." Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Some have described Alfred Peet as the “big bang” of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America’s expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet’s pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason’s one-of-a-kind taste, you’ll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason’s but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It’s the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

clip_missing_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: With a confetti of crunchy caramel pieces and fine sea salt, Tony's Chocolonely Caramel Sea Salt Milk Chocolate Bar is the life of the party. Our classic 32% milk chocolate is all dressed up with all-natural, non-GMO ingredients and made with traceable cocoa. Most importantly, our Fairtrade Certified chocolate exists to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that helps us tell an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our fun, crunchy milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.7 oz. Caramel Sea Salt Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt—the chocolate bar that delivers the perfect combination of rich dark chocolate and a delightful crunch! Packed with 51% cocoa and whole almonds, each bite offers a perfect balance of bold, robust dark chocolate and the satisfying crunch of almonds, all beautifully enhanced by a touch of sea salt. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves the deep flavor of dark chocolate and the perfect contrast of salty and sweet! At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should be more than just a tasty indulgence—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 51% cocoa dark chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of almonds and a touch of sea salt to elevate the flavors. Whether you’re having a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of bold chocolate, crunchy nuts, and a hint of salt, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: “On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It’s visceral." Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Some have described Alfred Peet as the “big bang” of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America’s expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet’s pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason’s one-of-a-kind taste, you’ll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason’s but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It’s the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Great coffee brings friends and neighbors together like nothing else. That's why we created this medium roast to pay tribute to the time-honored pastime of lingering in the café, casually sipping an expertly brewed cup over conversation. The three Latin American coffees in this carefully crafted blend were selected for their balance and brightness, and the roast fine-tuned to brew the perfect medium-bodied cup. We decided to name it after our third café, opened by Alfred Peet in 1980 on Domingo Avenue in Berkeley, in the shadow of the Claremont Hotel. For more than three decades, Peet's regulars have gathered here to enjoy hand-crafted drinks and the camaraderie they inspire. And that's something worth commemorating. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: �On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It's visceral."

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ever since Alfred Peet opened the doors of his first small Berkeley shop in 1966, Peet's has been known as a pioneer of fine, distinctive coffees high-grown, higher quality, and deeply roasted to maximize flavor. Peet's House Blend Dark Roast Coffee is a perfect introduction to our signature style. First crafted by Mr. Peet, this blend of carefully selected, choice beans from our favorite Latin American origins brews a cup that's uniquely rich and approachable, with a pleasant spiciness. It's deep-roasted by hand in small batches to impart the most flavor and aroma. And like all our coffees, it's delivered unimaginably fresh. Bright, balanced flavors and medium body make House Blend inviting and easy to love. Mr. Peet used to call it a "starter coffee, recommending it to new customers as their "intro" to the Peet's style. And more than five decades later, Peetniks everywhere are still at home with House.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In Colombia, luminosa means "shining or bright". Peet's Luminosa Breakfast Blend Light Roast Coffee layers subtle sweetness from Colombia with just the right touch of Ethiopia floral aromatics, a pair we knew would go perfectly together. We started with a coffee from the Huila region in Colombia's highlands, a place where beans are cultivated over 4,500 feet and known for their smooth, sweet character. Then to Ethiopia, coffee's birthplace, where unique varieties yield exquisite coffees with delicate aromas. Formerly known as Colombia Luminosa, we approached this bright blend, our first light roast, as we do all our coffees: carefully select the very best beans, then hand roast them in small batches to achieve their utmost flavor.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Big Bang Medium Roast Coffee is our signature medium roast created to celebrate Alfred Peet and our 50th anniversary. Some have described Alfred Peet as the "big bang" of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America's expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet's pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason's one-of-a-kind taste, you'll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason's but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It's the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee—the perfect blend of sweet and salty indulgence! This fan-favorite bar combines 42% dark milk chocolate with crunchy pretzel pieces and a sweet toffee crunch. Each bite is an irresistible combination of rich dark milk chocolate, salty pretzel pieces, and the sweet, chewy goodness of toffee. Wrapped in a vibrant purple wrapper, it’s a candy that’s as fun to look at as it is to eat! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste great—it should make a difference. That’s why our Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 42% dark milk chocolate, the crunch of the pretzels, and the sweet, buttery flavor of the toffee. Whether you’re enjoying a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Milk Chocolate Bar with Pretzel and Toffee is sure to satisfy every craving. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Chocolonely is more than just chocolate; it’s a mission driven brand that seeks to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. With Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, each bite you take can help combat the widespread issues of child labor, forced labor, and unsustainable farming practices. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a sustainable, ethical, and transparent supply chain that prioritizes farmers and the environment. Our chocolate bars and chocolate chunks come in a wide range of irresistible flavors, perfect for snacks or desserts. From Milk Chocolate to Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt, each variety is crafted with care to provide a truly indulgent experience. For those who crave a mix of everything, our Tiny Tony Variety Pack offers 14 individually wrapped chunks in 6 delicious flavors, including Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt, Honey Almond Nougat, Almond Sea Salt, and Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee—a delight for every taste. These chocolate bars make the perfect gift, whether for a birthday, holiday, or special occasion. And with chocolate this good, there’s no reason to wait! At Tony’s, we also focus on the long term—we work directly with cocoa cooperatives for at least five years to build lasting relationships and create sustainable change. This stability allows farmers to invest in improved farming practices, increase their yields, and reduce deforestation. Tony’s even implements a Child Labor Monitoring and Remediation System to encourage that all workers are regarded with fairness and respect. By purchasing Tony’s Chocolonely, you’re choosing chocolate made with clean ingredients and supporting a movement that demands transparency in the cocoa industry. So whether you’re grabbing a quick snack, enjoying a cozy evening with chocolate desserts, or looking for a sweet gift, know that Tony’s is the chocolate you can feel good about. Join us in the fight for a fairer, more sustainable world. Milk Chocolate: Tony’s classic creamy, dreamy Fairtrade-certified milk chocolate Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt: Tony’s classic milk chocolate with crunchy caramel and flakey sea salt Milk Chocolate Honey Almond Nougat: Milk chocolate with sticky, flavor-packed honey almond nougat Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee: A creamy, intensely tasty base of 42% milk chocolate with savory pretzels pieces and sweet, chewy toffee bits Dark Chocolate: Tony’s classic, robust yet creamy, dark chocolate Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt: Tony’s dark chocolate packed with deliciously nutty almonds and flakey sea salt

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony's Chocolonely Milk Chocolate Bar is a silky-smooth and downright delicious 32% milk chocolate bar that's changing the chocolate industry. These vibrant red-wrapped wonders are made with traceable cocoa and exist to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Our all-natural bars were Fairtrade Certified from the start and made with outstanding non-GMO ingredients. You’ll notice that each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that makes it a bit difficult to share equally. With these unequal divisions, we present an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our outstanding milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.8 oz. Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

The Milk Hazelnut Bar is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the milk chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of the hazelnuts. Together, they create a harmonious balance of textures and flavors that is simply unforgettable. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, The Milk Hazelnut Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy chocolate and crunchy nuts, all in one delicious, satisfying bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Get ready for a campfire classic, now in snackable form! Tony’s S’mores Mix Lil' Bits are the perfect snack for anyone craving that nostalgic s’mores flavor. Packed with fluffy, melt-in-your-mouth marshmallows, crispy graham cracker pieces, coated in rich milk chocolate, every bite delivers the ultimate balance of sweet, crunchy, and chocolatey goodness. Whether you’re at home, work, or on the go, these convenient, bite-sized nibbles make it easy to enjoy the taste of s’mores anytime, anywhere. Perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth, sharing with friends, or packing for an outdoor adventure, these S’mores Snackable Bits are the ideal snack for every occasion. At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste amazing—it should make a positive impact. That’s why every bite of our S’mores Snackable Bits is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. When you choose Tony’s, you’re not just indulging in a delicious candy; you’re supporting a movement that supports cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in fair, safe conditions. We are committed to creating a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry, and every purchase helps drive this mission forward. Tony’s S’mores Snackable Bits are perfect for everyone who loves the classic campfire tradition, but without the need for a fire. Whether you’re taking a break during work, hanging out at home, or looking for a sweet snack on the go, these delicious bites are easy to grab and indulge in. They offer a delightful texture with the chewiness of the marshmallow, the crunch of the graham crackers, and the creamy, smooth richness of Tony’s signature milk chocolate. And be warned—these irresistible snackable bits tend to run out quickly, so grab a bag (or two). Introduce yourself to a snack that’s as fun as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Rainbow Tasting Pack is the perfect way to experience the best of Tony’s chocolate in one colorful and fun package. This variety pack features 6 of our most beloved flavors, offering something for every chocolate lover. From the smooth, creamy texture of Milk Chocolate to the indulgent sweetness of Milk Caramel Sea Salt, this pack has all the delicious options you crave. The Milk Chocolate Nougat delivers a chewy, satisfying bite, while the Dark Almond Sea Salt bar brings a perfect balance of bold, rich dark chocolate with crunchy almonds and a touch of sea salt. If you’re a fan of deep cocoa, the 70% Dark Chocolate is the perfect choice for a more intense chocolate experience. All these bars come in our bright, cheerful rainbow packaging, making it a fun gift or a vibrant addition to your snack stash. At Tony’s, we believe that great chocolate should make a positive impact. That’s why each bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, supporting cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a movement for a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry. Whether you’re sharing with friends, yourself, or looking for a thoughtful gift, the Rainbow Tasting Pack offers a wide variety of flavors that will satisfy every chocolate craving. The fun, colorful packaging makes it ideal for gifting during any celebration, and with its mix of classic milk and dark chocolate options, everyone can find their favorite. So why not indulge yourself or someone you love to a colorful and exciting experience that does good for the world as well as for your taste buds? With every purchase of the Rainbow Tasting Pack, you’re not just enjoying the finest chocolate—you’re contributing to a fairer chocolate industry.

recommendations.title: Resolve category uncertainty without discarding verified offers
recommendations.detail: 117 products still need category evidence. Their valid offers remain browsable under Needs category review; they are excluded from automatic meal matching.

recommendations.title: Recover source data before guessing from images
recommendations.detail: 522 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.

recommendations.title: Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
recommendations.detail: Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.

recommendations.title: Use gold labels as training data
recommendations.detail: Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.
